description: Delegate payment authority from a parent agent to a sub-agent with explicit limits. The sub-agent can only spend up to the delegated ceiling. Delegation can be revoked at any time. Use in multi-agent workflows where an orchestrator authorises a worker agent to make payments on its behalf.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when this delegation expires. Omit for no expiry.

max_per_tx.description: Maximum USD per transaction for the sub-agent

max_total.description: Lifetime spending ceiling for this delegation

policy_id.description: Policy ID to inherit (optional — inherits parent policy if omitted)

name: policy.delegate
